newsitem.title: USA: Dow jumps more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow jumps more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average gained more than 50 points in early morning trading on Tuesday, as overnight comments by Japan seemed to ease Wall Street's worries that the Japanese might sell U.S. Treasuries.

At 9:33 a.m. EDT the index of 30 blue-chip issues was up 50.66 points at 7,654.92, recovering part of Monday's 192-point plunge. The New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading were activated when the Dow rose 50 points.
